messages.text: I’ll trace the feed startup and transfer ownership paths, then make a focused change in the candidate files and run the relevant checks.

The panel listener starts after `feed.start()`, so it misses a synchronous cached packet. I’ll attach that listener first and keep a sequence number for display updates, while continuing to record every decoded frame. The telemetry listener will retain its current delta-only startup order.

The focused scenarios pass: the initial frame appears immediately, reversed decode completion does not roll back the display, and history still records both frames. This workspace has no Git repository, so I’ll finish with a syntax check and a reentrant close check.

Updated [src/progress.js](/workspace/src/progress.js) so the panel subscribes before the feed starts. A warm source’s synchronous initial frame now reaches the panel. Decoded frames still enter progress history, while an older frame that finishes decoding late cannot move the display backward.

The focused Node scenarios passed for initial delivery, reversed decode completion, hide and retry, telemetry, and a reentrant close. The syntax check passed. There is no Git repository in this workspace, so `git diff --check` could not run.
